verdict: PASS with firmware pad constraint: keep RP2350 PADS_QSPI at SLEWFAST=0 (default 4 mA / ~2.4 ns). Because In2.Cu sits 1.065 mm from In1.Cu GND (single-ended Z0 = 109.21 Ohm, k_L = 0.36 at 0.40 mm pitch), enabling SLEWFAST=1 causes 3.77 V overshoot & 313 mV crosstalk, whereas SLEWFAST=0 cuts crosstalk 5.1x to 61 mV with zero ringing at 75 MHz XIP. Remarkably, 3D FDTD proves p2-132's tight edge-coupled USB_DP/USB_DM pair on In2.Cu (w=0.15 mm, gap=0.1875 mm) achieves Z_diff = 92.47 Ohm (within 2.8% of 90 Ohm USB spec, S11 = -51.29 dB @ 60 MHz)!
